text.arabic_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَٰتِكُمْ فِى حَيَاتِكُمُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهَا فَٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْسُقُونَ

words.gloss_range: opening connector for a temporal judgment scene, with both continuity and fresh-scene force

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: NOUN_ABSTRACT functioning as adverb of time (ẓarf zamān); manṣūb (accusative) indicating temporal frame

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as continuation and scene-launch at once. It carries the accounting logic from 46:19 into a concrete judgment tableau, and the following {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) makes that transition temporal rather than merely additive. The opening also participates in a wa-yawma judgment-scene formula with parallels at 6:93, 25:22, and 46:34.

topics.headline: connector carries accounting into scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the judgment scene grows out of the prior accounting principle rather than beginning as an isolated report.
topics.reason: The QAC row allows conjunction or resumption, and the boundary rows support a linked but newly staged temporal clause.

topics.headline: wa-yawma eschatological opener
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening as a recognizable judgment-scene formula that moves from principle to enacted confrontation.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows compare the opening to temporal scene introductions at 6:93, 25:22, and 46:34; this is formulaic support, not a separate parse.

words.gloss_range: accusative temporal frame, first indefinite scene-time answered by later definite today
words.root_gloss_range: day or time as a bounded judgment frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: ADV accusative definite; temporal adverb marking "this very day" of judgment

words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) is a fronted temporal container: the day is defined by exposure, accusation, verdict, and causes. Its bare form is later answered by {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-yawma}}), so the ayah moves from 'the day when' into the verdict's immediate 'today.' The day-word also belongs to the surah's exposure-and-accounting thread, especially the later judgment scenes at 46:34 and 46:35.

topics.headline: fronted day contains the whole scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the entire ayah enclosed inside a bounded day of judgment before the actors are named.
topics.reason: QAC and grammar rows identify the word as accusative temporal adverb rather than subject.

topics.headline: opening day answered by today
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the temporal pivot from a narrated judgment day to a present verdict inside the same scene.
topics.reason: The contrast between word 2 and word 17 is supported by form, position, and the local repayment pairing.

topics.headline: day joins exposure and recompense networks
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the date word is not neutral timekeeping but part of a repeated exposure-and-repayment setting.
topics.reason: The distribution and boundary rows support same-surah judgment framing; the phonetic row is retained as secondary cadence evidence.

words.gloss_range: passive exposure or presentation, directed against the fire
words.root_gloss_range: spreading or displaying something before view, locally judicial exposure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: PREP governing genitive al-nāri; marks direction/adversarial relation in this context
NOUN_CONCRETE definite genitive (governed by ʿalā); al- is anaphoric — presupposes known referent

words.prose: {{ar:يُعْرَضُ}} ({{tr:yuʿraḍu}}) makes the condemned group grammatically passive and visible: they are displayed, while the presenter remains unstated. With {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) {{ar:ٱلنَّارِ}} ({{tr:al-nāri}}), the display is not neutral viewing but hostile presentation against the fire, part of the same exposure formula that recurs at 46:34 and 40:46.

topics.headline: passive display focuses exposed recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that those who covered are made visible while the presenting agent is left unstated.
topics.reason: The local form is passive imperfect and the root evidence coherently supports display becoming forensic exposure.

topics.headline: presentation takes hostile direction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the presentation land against the fire rather than remain an abstract inspection.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence and QAC grammar place the prepositional complement after the passive verb.

topics.headline: same-surah and cross-surah fire display formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as part of a recurring doom-day display pattern, including 46:34 and 40:46.
topics.reason: The concrete references support formulaic comparison without overriding the local parse.

words.gloss_range: definite relative pronoun identifying the passive subject by its action

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: PV perfect 3mp; no explicit object — used intransitively or with elided object

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) does the identifying work before the direct accusation begins. It makes the displayed subject a known class, but that class is completed only by {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}), so identity is routed through the act of disbelief rather than name, lineage, or appearance.

topics.headline: relative subject defined by action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is identified by what they did before it is addressed directly.
topics.reason: QAC and CRITICAL rows align: the relative pronoun is the passive subject and its clause supplies the defining marker.

topics.headline: definite relative summons recognized class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees judgment aimed at a recognizable conduct-defined category, not at an unnamed mass.
topics.reason: The definite relative form supports discourse-known classification while the clause supplies the conduct basis.

words.gloss_range: objectless perfect disbelief as defining stance, then exposed and unpacked
words.root_gloss_range: covering or concealing, locally denial that is reversed into exposure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: IV_PASS imperfect passive 3ms; subject is alladhīna kafarū; ʿalā al-nāri = directional complement

words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) has no explicit object, so the denial is not narrowed to one item; it defines the class. The covering force of the root is reversed by {{ar:يُعْرَضُ}} ({{tr:yuʿraḍu}}): those who covered are exposed, then the final causes unpack that disbelief as consumption, arrogance, and transgression. The same class moves from turning away in 46:3 and rejecting in 46:10 toward fire-presentation in 46:34.

topics.headline: objectless disbelief becomes identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that disbelief is grammatical identity here, not one isolated denial of a named object.
topics.reason: The QAC row notes no explicit object, and the relative-clause structure makes the verb identify the subject.

topics.headline: covering is reversed into exposure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the irony that a covering stance ends in public exposure before the fire.
topics.reason: Root-image rows support the reversal, while local syntax keeps the selected sense as disbelief.

topics.headline: same-surah disbelief arc reaches punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader links this exposed class to the surah’s wider arc from rejection and avoidance to punishment (46:3, 46:10, 46:34).
topics.reason: The intertext rows give concrete same-surah and formulaic comparisons; they illuminate recurrence without changing the local verb sense.

words.gloss_range: preposition directing passive presentation toward or against the fire

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: IV_PASS imperfect passive 3ms; subject is alladhīna kafarū; ʿalā al-nāri = directional complement
NOUN_CONCRETE definite genitive (governed by ʿalā); al- is anaphoric — presupposes known referent

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) completes the route of exposure. After {{ar:يُعْرَضُ}} ({{tr:yuʿraḍu}}), it makes {{ar:ٱلنَّارِ}} ({{tr:al-nāri}}) both destination and adversarial surface, so the group is not merely shown a scene; it is presented upon and against the fire as the object of judgment.

topics.headline: preposition lands display against fire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition turns presentation into confrontation with the fire.
topics.reason: QAC marks the preposition as governing the fire and as directional or adversarial in this context.

topics.headline: upon and against remain active
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels both the spatial landing and the adversarial pressure of the phrase.
topics.reason: The semantic range of the preposition is narrowed by the passive presentation frame.

words.gloss_range: definite known eschatological fire, concrete destructive endpoint
words.root_gloss_range: fire and light field; locally the destructive fire branch is selected
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّارِ}} ({{tr:al-nāri}}) is definite, so the fire is treated as known. The root field can include light-language, but this concrete noun selects destructive fire; its recurrence at 46:34 makes it the surah’s repeated endpoint for exposure.

topics.headline: definite fire is known endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fire is not introduced from scratch but presupposed as the known judgment endpoint.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the noun as definite genitive governed by the preposition, and the CRITICAL rows read the article as anaphoric.

topics.headline: root range narrows to destructive fire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the selected branch: the n-w-r field appears here as fire, not beneficial light.
topics.reason: The local surface is the concrete fire noun; broader root branches are relevant only as contrast.

topics.headline: fire returns in exposure scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this fire to the later exposure scene in 46:34, where the same endpoint returns.
topics.reason: Concrete same-surah recurrence supports a local frame; the sound row is retained as secondary support for closure.

words.gloss_range: second-person perfect Form IV causative: you caused your good things to depart
words.root_gloss_range: going away, departure, and expenditure imagery; locally causative depletion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: NOUN_ABSTRACT feminine plural accusative + 2mp pronoun suffix; object of adhhabtum

words.prose: {{ar:أَذْهَبْتُمْ}} ({{tr:adhhabtum}}) opens the direct speech with responsibility: the addressees caused their own good things to depart. Its Form IV causative and direct object {{ar:طَيِّبَٰتِكُمْ}} ({{tr:ṭayyibātikum}}) keep the charge from sounding like accidental loss or external wronging, while accepted interrogative readings turn the same charge into sharper rebuke without changing what was depleted. The same Form IV can describe divine removal of grief in 35:34, but here human-caused removal is wasteful depletion.

topics.headline: causative verb makes them agents of depletion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that loss is charged to the addressees as an act they caused, not as something done to them.
topics.reason: QAC and form rows identify a transitive Form IV perfect with the good things as object.

topics.headline: perfect accusation begins the address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the report become direct second-person indictment, with completed consumption set before present recompense.
topics.reason: The grammar and boundary rows consistently mark a shift into direct address and completed second-person action.

topics.headline: departure image and qiraat rebuke intensify charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels consumption as making an allotment vanish, with variant readings exposing the reproachful force of the accusation.
topics.reason: The root image and accepted variant readings are useful pressure, while the local object and causative syntax keep the sense narrowed to depletion.

words.gloss_range: personal plural good things, the direct object depleted
words.root_gloss_range: wholesome, pleasant, good, and lawful quality; locally consumable allotments
words.prose: {{ar:طَيِّبَٰتِكُمْ}} ({{tr:ṭayyibātikum}}) names the depleted object as their own good things. The suffix personalizes the allocation, the plural makes it cumulative, and the root keeps pleasantness, wholesomeness, and lawful goodness together; the blame is not that such goods exist, but that they were exhausted in the nearer life.

topics.headline: suffix makes good things personally allotted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the depleted goods are charged as their own allotted portion.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative object of the causative verb and carries the second-person plural suffix.

topics.headline: good things are wholesome and plural
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the indictment concerns misuse of many wholesome provisions, not a blanket condemnation of lawful good things.
topics.reason: Root, form, and cross-reference rows preserve qualitative range while QAC fixes the local object role.

topics.headline: pleasant goods invert into punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader catches the reversal from pleasant goods to punishment inside a system that does not wrong them.
topics.reason: The local sequence from good things to punishment supports semantic inversion; the sound row is secondary.

words.gloss_range: preposition making worldly life the temporal container of depletion
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes the first accusation occur inside a bounded span: their worldly life. Its later repetition before the earth maps the indictment across time and space: consumption in life, arrogance in the land.

topics.headline: life becomes container of depletion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the good things were exhausted within the bounded container of worldly life.
topics.reason: QAC marks temporal function with the following genitive life phrase.

topics.headline: repeated fī maps time and space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a grid of accusation: first the time of consumption, later the arena of arrogance.
topics.reason: The repeated preposition is locally visible at words 10 and 25, with distinct temporal and spatial complements.

words.gloss_range: their lived span, possessed and qualified as nearer-world life
words.root_gloss_range: life and vitality; contested modesty associations survive only as secondary pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: NOUN_ABSTRACT definite; adjective modifying ḥayāt in iḍāfa; elative/comparative form ("the nearer/lower")

words.prose: {{ar:حَيَاتِكُمُ}} ({{tr:ḥayātikumu}}) personalizes the time-frame with the suffix: it was their lived span. Because it is immediately qualified by {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:al-dunyā}}), life here is not absolute life but the nearer-world life in which their allotment was spent, set against the later life-giving claim in 46:33; the life/modesty association adds a secondary dignity pressure without replacing the local life sense.

topics.headline: suffix makes life their own span
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that judgment addresses their own lived span, not an abstract idea of life.
topics.reason: The word is genitive after the preposition and carries the second-person suffix, matching the direct-address turn.

topics.headline: life is locked to the nearer world
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the consumed life as a bounded near-life frame, set against later revival language in 46:33.
topics.reason: The following modifier and dominant life-world collocation support the frame; 46:33 provides same-surah contrast.

topics.headline: life root keeps dignity pressure nearby
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses that squandering vitality also carries a dignity or shame pressure, while life remains the local sense.
topics.reason: The derivational discussion is relevant as pressure but narrowed by the clear local life construction.

words.gloss_range: definite nearer or lower life, the limited layer of consumption
words.root_gloss_range: nearness and lowness; locally the comparative worldly-life modifier

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: NOUN_ABSTRACT feminine plural accusative + 2mp pronoun suffix; object of adhhabtum
ADV accusative definite; temporal adverb marking "this very day" of judgment

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:al-dunyā}}) narrows the possessed life to the nearer, lower layer. Its elative form implies a horizon beyond this life, so exhausting {{ar:طَيِّبَٰتِكُمْ}} ({{tr:ṭayyibātikum}}) here becomes loss when {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-yawma}}) arrives as the day of repayment.

topics.headline: elative marks the near lower life
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the consumed life is the near layer, not the whole horizon of existence.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as definite modifier of life and the form rows support elative comparative pressure.

topics.headline: near life is the field of finite enjoyment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects near-life enjoyment with later judgment-today repayment, so consumption is read across two temporal layers.
topics.reason: The collocation and local sequence support the contrast between near-life depletion and verdict time.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating the second completed consumption charge
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the second perfect verb without collapsing it into the first. Depletion and enjoyment become a paired indictment: they made the good things depart, and they extracted enjoyment from them or from the life that held them. The matching second-person perfect endings make the two charges echo inside the direct address.

topics.headline: conjunction pairs depletion and enjoyment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two coordinated charges rather than one vague accusation of luxury.
topics.reason: QAC and CRITICAL rows identify the conjunction as coordinating the two perfect second-person verbs.

topics.headline: short connector resets the second charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second-person perfect pair as a local echo inside the direct address.
topics.reason: The morphology and cadence rows support the pairing while remaining secondary to the syntactic coordination.

words.gloss_range: Form X second-person enjoyment, seeking or extracting temporary benefit
words.root_gloss_range: temporary benefit, enjoyment, and use; locally extracted enjoyment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: PREP prefix on pronoun hā; instrumental or accompaniment

words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَمْتَعْتُم}} ({{tr:istamtaʿtum}}) is not bare pleasure; Form X presents enjoyment as sought and extracted from temporary benefit. Its object comes through {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), whose feminine pronoun can point back to the good things or the worldly life, so the charge covers both finite goods and the life-field that contained them. After the depletion verb, this second perfect completes a two-part consumption sequence: depletion first, extracted enjoyment second.

topics.headline: Form X makes enjoyment actively sought
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices active extraction of temporary benefit, not merely incidental enjoyment.
topics.reason: QAC identifies Form X, and the root/form rows coherently support requestive or extractive enjoyment.

topics.headline: bihā completes and widens the object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the enjoyment tied to a feminine antecedent that can keep both the goods and worldly life in view.
topics.reason: The prepositional complement is grammatically required locally; antecedent ambiguity is plausible because both candidates are feminine.

topics.headline: second perfect completes consumption couplet
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the accusation as a completed two-part consumption sequence: depletion first, extracted enjoyment second.
topics.reason: Local coordination, repeated second-person perfect morphology, and the finite-benefit field all support the couplet.

words.gloss_range: prepositional object marker with feminine pronoun, allowing goods/life antecedent ambiguity

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: NOUN_ABSTRACT feminine plural accusative + 2mp pronoun suffix; object of adhhabtum
GERUND genitive (governed by fī) + 2mp possessive suffix; iḍāfa with al-dunyā
NOUN_ABSTRACT definite; adjective modifying ḥayāt in iḍāfa; elative/comparative form ("the nearer/lower")

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) supplies the channel of enjoyment through a feminine pronoun. Because the antecedent can be {{ar:طَيِّبَٰتِكُمْ}} ({{tr:ṭayyibātikum}}) or {{ar:حَيَاتِكُمُ}} ({{tr:ḥayātikumu}}) {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:al-dunyā}}), the indictment remains deliberately wide: they enjoyed the goods and the worldly life around them before the consequence pivot arrives.

topics.headline: feminine pronoun keeps goods and life live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of enjoyment can include both the depleted goods and the worldly-life setting.
topics.reason: Attachment and referent evidence allow both feminine antecedents; neither is contradicted locally.

topics.headline: preposition closes enjoyment beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the enjoyment phrase sealed just before the consequence marker turns accusation into verdict.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the pronoun and sits at the end of the consumption unit before the causal pivot.

words.gloss_range: causal-consequential pivot from past accusation to present verdict

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: ADV accusative definite; temporal adverb marking "this very day" of judgment

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the ayah’s hinge. It turns completed depletion and enjoyment into consequence, then fuses with {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-yawma}}) so the old actions become an immediate verdict: because of that, today you are repaid.

topics.headline: fa turns charge into verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the legal movement from accusation to sentence in a single particle.
topics.reason: QAC marks sababiyya and CRITICAL rows consistently identify the central pivot.

topics.headline: particle shifts past deeds into present repayment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees perfect past actions converted into present passive recompense.
topics.reason: The particle stands between the completed direct-address verbs and the present verdict clause.

words.gloss_range: definite today inside the scene, verdict-time rather than general day
words.root_gloss_range: day or time as immediate judgment point

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: CONJ prefix; sababiyya (causal-consequential) — connects the accusation to the verdict
NOUN_ABSTRACT functioning as adverb of time (ẓarf zamān); manṣūb (accusative) indicating temporal frame

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-yawma}}) makes the opening day present to the addressees. Joined to {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}), it compresses consequence and time, answering {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) by turning the judgment frame into the verdict’s 'today.'

topics.headline: today makes judgment immediate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scene collapse from narrated day to immediate verdict-time.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a definite temporal adverb, and the fused particle form supports consequence tied to time.

topics.headline: yawma becomes al-yawma
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the ayah’s architecture: opening day, completed consumption, present recompense, then habitual causes.
topics.reason: Local repetition and tense sequence support the temporal shift; same-surah recurrence supplies wider judgment-day backdrop.

words.gloss_range: passive present recompense, proportional return with object punishment
words.root_gloss_range: recompense, repayment, or return; locally punitive requital

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: IV_PASS imperfect passive 3ms; subject is alladhīna kafarū; ʿalā al-nāri = directional complement

words.prose: {{ar:تُجْزَوْنَ}} ({{tr:tujzawna}}) makes the addressees passive recipients of repayment. The agent is unstated, but the root makes the punishment a proportional return and pulls the humiliation-punishment phrase into the verdict; it also mirrors {{ar:يُعْرَضُ}} ({{tr:yuʿraḍu}}), so the same group is first displayed and then recompensed.

topics.headline: passive verdict makes them recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict is enacted upon the addressees while the recompensing agent remains grammatically unstated.
topics.reason: QAC marks passive imperfect second plural and the CRITICAL rows note the retained verdict object.

topics.headline: punishment is framed as recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees humiliating punishment as juridical return, not arbitrary harm.
topics.reason: The j-z-y root and local object phrase support repayment semantics, continuing the accounting logic from 46:19.

topics.headline: display and recompense frame the group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that two passives frame the scene: presented first, repaid next.
topics.reason: Both local verbs are imperfect passives and share the same judged group.

words.gloss_range: retained object of recompense, punishment defined by humiliation
words.root_gloss_range: torment and, in broader root range, sweetness; locally punitive reversal

NOUN_ABSTRACT feminine plural accusative + 2mp pronoun suffix; object of adhhabtum

words.prose: {{ar:عَذَابَ}} ({{tr:ʿadhāba}}) is the punishment received under passive recompense. Its construct with {{ar:ٱلْهُونِ}} ({{tr:al-hūni}}) makes humiliation define the penalty, while the root’s sweetness/torment tension sharpens the reversal from {{ar:طَيِّبَٰتِكُمْ}} ({{tr:ṭayyibātikum}}) to punishment.

topics.headline: punishment remains the object received
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the passive construction still names the concrete penalty received.

topics.headline: construct defines punishment by humiliation

topics.headline: pleasant consumption reverses into punishment

words.gloss_range: definite humiliation as genitive substance of punishment
words.root_gloss_range: lightness, ease, contempt, and humiliation; locally abasement

The rare noun form, the accepted hawān variant, and the antithesis to {{ar:تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ}} ({{tr:tastakbirūna}}) all point the same way: self-claimed greatness is answered by abasement.

topics.headline: iḍāfa makes humiliation the substance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that humiliation is the defining substance of the punishment rather than a loose adjective.

topics.headline: humiliation answers self-magnification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees exact moral reversal: those who sought height receive lowered contempt.
topics.reason: The root relation and local pairing with the arrogance clause support the antithesis.

topics.headline: rare noun and variant confirm nominal humiliation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun choice is marked inside the broader humiliation field.
topics.reason: The rarity and accepted variant rows support a marked nominal humiliation reading without changing the local construct parse.

words.gloss_range: first causal bi introducing the reasons for punishment

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) begins the legal explanation after the verdict. Its {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) phrase gives the first ground, and the later repeated {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) makes arrogance and transgression two parallel causes for one humiliating punishment.

topics.headline: bi-mā turns verdict into justification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not stop at sentence; it names why the sentence is deserved.
topics.reason: QAC marks causal function and the following clause supplies the reason for punishment.

topics.headline: two bimā clauses distribute causes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees arrogance and transgression as matched grounds, not one cause plus an afterthought.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence at words 7-15 moves from making good things go away, through enjoying them, to being repaid today.
baseline_models.mechanism: Worldly goods form a finite stock deliberately run through to its endpoint. The verse does not make their goodness unreal; it makes one-way consumption answerable to a later counter-payment.

activation_trace.role: Going away supplies the irreversible depletion that turns possession into an exhausted allotment.
The good as opposed to the corrupt preserves the tension that genuinely good things can be wrongly allocated.
Pleasurable benefit supplies the immediate use that consumes the finite stock.
Extension until a limit gives enjoyment a temporal arc that can be completed and closed.
Countering an act with its return supplies the settlement phase after the spending phase.
The doubled day becomes both the enclosing event and the severe turn from expenditure to settlement.

changed_reading.before: They enjoyed worldly pleasures and are later punished for excess.
changed_reading.after: They knowingly exhausted an intrinsically good allotment inside immediate enjoyment, and the severe present day answers that one-way depletion with counter-payment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive presentation at words 2-6 is followed by humiliation at word 17 and self-magnification without right at words 20-24.
baseline_models.mechanism: Those characterized by covering are made visible before a fire that both burns and illuminates. Their unsupported enlargement of rank is answered not only by pain but by public diminishment under disclosed reality.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something out for sight makes the scene an exposure rather than mere transportation.
Covering supplies the concealed condition that the presentation reverses.
Blocking truth specifies what the agents had kept from acknowledgment.
Kindled fire supplies the literal destination while retaining an exposing luminosity.
Claimed greatness supplies the inflated status that the sentence reverses.
Being treated as slight supplies the social and affective inverse of claimed greatness.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the missing warrant for their self-elevation.

changed_reading.before: Unbelievers are brought to fire and punished for pride.
changed_reading.after: The scene is an enforced unveiling: agents of concealment are displayed in illuminating fire, and unsupported self-elevation is publicly converted into lowness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final causal clause joins self-enlargement on earth without right to the act named at word 27.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sole supplied branch for the final root pictures moist fruit leaving its peel. Read beside enlargement and a right that should fit its place, wrongdoing becomes a pressure-driven exit from rightful containment rather than an unstructured label.

activation_trace.role: A fresh date breaking out of its peel supplies the concrete boundary-breach image.
Increase beyond smallness supplies the pressure of expansion behind the breach.
A right that fits its proper joint or vessel supplies the containing order that is violated.
The lower ground supplies the spatial field in which the illicit expansion is enacted.

changed_reading.before: Their fisq is a generic synonym for disobedience.
changed_reading.after: Their self-magnification pushes them out through the fitting boundary of right, like soft fruit rupturing its protective peel.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence makes arrogance an epistemic ranking system: testimony is present, yet goodness is rejected because socially disfavored people arrived first. The focus charge of magnifying oneself without right therefore targets a status rule used to decide what may count as truth.

activation_trace.role: Claimed greatness anchors the context's status logic in the focus accusation.
Correspondence with reality anchors the contrast between evidence and an unwarranted rank test.
Present witnessing supplies evidence that precedes and survives the arrogant refusal.
The same greatness branch directly couples the refusal to the focus's self-elevation.
Beneficial good is the very category they submit to a social-status test.
Precedence and racing supply the comparative hierarchy used to reject the message.
A falsehood turned away from truth is the label produced after the rank test fails.

structural_cues: 46:10 places witnessing immediately before arrogance.
46:11 conditions goodness on who preceded whom and then relabels the message as an old falsehood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies witness, arrogance, and a precedence-based objection; I infer that social rank becomes their rule for recognizing truth. A narrower reading as envy of early believers remains live.

changed_reading.before: They were generally too proud to accept the truth.
changed_reading.after: They treated social precedence as evidence, so self-magnification without right names a rank-based epistemology that overrides actual witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby positive life-course is made of costly carrying, received blessing, gratitude, deliberate work, and repair extending into descendants. Against it, the focus does not oppose pleasure to bare deprivation; it opposes self-terminating consumption to grateful transmission and repair.

activation_trace.role: Real goodness anchors the question of what should have been done with the life allotment.
Immediate pleasurable benefit supplies the self-contained use contrasted with transmission.
Hidden carrying that bears fruit supplies a costly, generative use of life.
Hardship borne despite aversion prevents the positive model from collapsing into pleasant self-use.
Recognizing a benefit and its giver supplies the alternative relation to good things.
Received good condition identifies worldly benefit as a gift with relational direction.
Repair opposed to corruption supplies the outward and intergenerational result absent from mere enjoyment.

structural_cues: 46:15 moves from parental burden through maturity to gratitude, good work, and repair in descendants.
46:16 immediately follows with acceptance of the best work and passing over bad acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a generational chain of burden, blessing, gratitude, and repair; I infer that these are alternative uses of worldly good. The focus may still refer more narrowly to luxury rather than every entrusted benefit.

changed_reading.before: The verse is an ascetic rebuke of having pleasure in worldly goods.
changed_reading.after: The rebuke targets benefits consumed without gratitude, costly care, repair, or transmission; pleasure is contrasted with sterile use, not simply with renunciation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's repayment formula belongs to a paired and graded outcome architecture. Reward is likewise tied to past action, then the immediately preceding verse adds degree-by-degree completion without withheld right; punishment is calibrated fulfillment rather than an undifferentiated outburst.

activation_trace.role: Counter-payment anchors the focus outcome in the surrounding account.
The same counter-payment branch supplies the positive parallel to the focus sentence.
Purposive action supplies the authored input to the positive outcome.
Movement by successive degrees supplies differentiation rather than a single flat penalty.
Completion without deficit supplies exact settlement of what the actions generated.
Withholding a due right supplies the negated failure mode of the settlement.

structural_cues: 46:14 and 46:20 use parallel outcome-from-past-action syntax for opposite groups.
46:19 stands immediately before the focus and combines degrees, full payment, and negated wrong.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel repayment, degrees, full completion, and no withheld right; I infer that these govern the focus penalty's calibration. The degree statement could describe final stations broadly rather than each component of punishment.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is a uniform retaliatory sentence imposed after worldly pleasure.
changed_reading.after: It is the negative side of a symmetrical, graded account that fully returns purposive acts without arbitrary excess or withheld due.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later people see an approaching visible mass and name it as benefit-bearing rain; the narration reverses that valuation into wind-borne pain and total destruction. This makes the focus's relation between good things, enjoyment, and presentation also about trained misrecognition: appetite can mistake the approaching instrument of judgment for benefit.

activation_trace.role: Exposure for sight anchors the later seeing-and-misnaming sequence in the focus presentation.
The category of good supplies what the appetite-driven act of recognition claims to identify.
Pleasurable utility supplies the evaluative bias that expects benefit.
Something appearing from a direction supplies the visible object that is confidently misclassified.
Sky-poured water supplies the expected benefit projected onto the approaching mass.
Moving air supplies the actual carrier hidden by the rain interpretation.
Painful penalty supplies the revealed content of what had looked beneficial.
Extirpating destruction supplies the consequence that decisively falsifies the first valuation.
Dwellings as inhabited places become the empty residue visible after their occupants vanish.

structural_cues: 46:24 sequences sight, confident naming as rain, corrective reversal, and disclosure of punishment.
46:25 narrows what remains visible to dwellings and closes with the same repayment root used in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a visible approach misread as rain and revealed as destructive wind; I infer that this models the focus agents' pleasure-shaped valuation. The episode may instead illustrate impatient denial without redefining their earlier good things.

changed_reading.before: Their good things were accurately recognized goods that they merely overconsumed.
changed_reading.after: Alongside misuse of real goods, the context activates a second reading in which pleasure-trained judgment calls an approaching harm beneficial until exposure corrects sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: A nearby destroyed society had greater enablement and repeated faculties of hearing, sight, and heart, yet these capacities ceased to avail when used in knowing denial; the mocked reality then enclosed them. The focus's good things can therefore include human and civilizational capacities whose misuse cancels their benefit.

activation_trace.role: A useful provision for needs anchors the expansion from luxuries to enabling capacities.
Life understood as benefit supports reading faculties as part of the worldly life allotment.
Granted ability and establishment supply the larger stock of usable capacity.
Understanding that should issue in response supplies a faculty whose function is frustrated.
Inner discernment supplies another good capacity that fails to become guidance.
The inwardly kindled heart supplies the center where received evidence should have become recognition.
Sufficiency supplies the expressly negated result: the capacities do not avail their possessors.
Denial despite knowledge explains why available faculties fail to yield their proper benefit.
Descending harm that encloses its target supplies the final reversal of apparent mastery.

structural_cues: 46:26 explicitly compares the earlier people's greater establishment with the addressees' lesser establishment.
Hearing, sight, and hearts are each named before and after the statement that they did not avail, then denial and enclosure explain the failure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enablement, faculties, failed benefit, knowing denial, and enclosure; I infer that these faculties belong among the focus's good things. A material-luxury restriction for the focus noun remains plausible.

changed_reading.before: The good things are mainly consumable comforts and wealth.
changed_reading.after: They may also be powers of hearing, discernment, inward judgment, and social establishment: goods exhausted when their proper capacity to benefit is disabled by denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later call sets response against attempted evasion: nonresponse leaves a person unable to outstrip pursuit anywhere on earth and without a protecting patron. The focus's arrogance on earth thus carries a spatial-political illusion of immunity that the presentation scene terminates.

activation_trace.role: Claimed greatness anchors the imagined immunity in the focus charge.
The lower terrestrial domain supplies the field over which their status was asserted.
Answering a call supplies the rejected action that opens the escape sequence.
Getting beyond a pursuer supplies the expressly denied form of earthly escape.
The repeated earth root closes the very domain in which the focus agents magnified themselves.
Protective alliance supplies the social refuge that is also denied.
Deviation from the intended way supplies the resulting condition after nonresponse.

structural_cues: 46:32 runs from refusal to answer, through negated escape on earth, to negated patronage.
The same earth phrase links the failed escape directly to the arena of arrogance in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nonresponse, inability to outstrip on earth, and lack of patrons; I infer a false jurisdictional immunity inside the focus's earthly arrogance. A simpler statement of universal divine power remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Arrogance on earth is only a general description of proud conduct.
changed_reading.after: It includes acting as though terrestrial reach, rank, or alliances create an exempt zone; presentation to the fire is the collapse of that imagined jurisdiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-repetition of the focus tableau adds an explicit challenge, acknowledgment, and command to taste. Presentation is therefore an evidentiary sequence: denied truth is made visible, verbally conceded, and finally known through embodied experience.

activation_trace.role: Display for sight anchors the focus as the first stage of verification.
Blocking truth supplies the prior epistemic condition that verification overcomes.
The severe event frame marks the repeated tableau as the decisive disclosure.
The repeated display branch makes visual confrontation the first movement of the dialogue.
Repeated truth-blocking brackets the acknowledgment and identifies what the scene resolves.
Negation of the present condition supplies the interrogative test they can no longer maintain.
Reality matching what is presented supplies the proposition they are forced to concede.
Experiential testing supplies embodied knowledge after sight and admission.
Painful penalty is the reality that becomes experientially undeniable.

structural_cues: 46:34 repeats the focus's opening presentation almost verbatim.
The added sequence is visual confrontation, yes-or-no question, admission, then experiential imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition, question, concession, and tasting; I infer a progression from sight to verbal to embodied verification. The exchange may be rhetorical confirmation rather than a formal evidentiary procedure.

changed_reading.before: Being presented to fire only positions the condemned before punishment.
changed_reading.after: Presentation is the start of forced verification: what was blocked from truth becomes seen, admitted as real, and finally learned by experience.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed endpoint governs creation early in the packet, while the closing scene makes the former stay seem no more than a small part of daylight when the promised event is seen. The focus's contrast between worldly life and today becomes an allocation failure across radically unequal perceived durations.

activation_trace.role: A bounded duration anchors the two day markers that pivot the focus between life and settlement.
The nearer or lower life supplies the limited horizon within which the goods were spent.
Extension that reaches its endpoint makes enjoyment measurable against a terminating interval.
An assigned temporal limit supplies the packet's early boundary on created duration.
A duration called a day supplies the scale against which the former stay contracts.
An appointment bounded by time supplies the future event whose sight reorganizes remembered duration.
Staying in a place supplies the retrospectively compressed worldly residence.
Daylight opening supplies the small visible interval to which the stay is compared.

structural_cues: 46:20 places worldly life between two emphatic day markers.
46:35 explicitly compares the remembered stay with only part of a day once the promise is seen.
The hour expression in 46:35 is used structurally only because its supplied inventory has no citable time branch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed term and retrospective contraction of the former stay; I infer that this changes the focus from simple postponement to disastrous temporal allocation. The closing comparison may express felt brevity rather than a literal duration ratio.

changed_reading.before: They preferred a long present life to a later day of punishment.
changed_reading.after: They spent their finite good allotment on an interval that will collapse in retrospect to a fraction of daylight, while the settlement day becomes the dominant temporal reality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet first praises becoming straight, later names guidance toward a straight extended route, and closes by repeating the focus's breach-root at the destruction boundary. This activates a coherent geometry: right is a fitted course, arrogance swells beyond it, and fisq is the exit from its protective line.

activation_trace.role: Fruit leaving its peel anchors the focus wrongdoing as an outward breach.
A right fitted to its joint or vessel anchors the breached order as properly aligned containment.
Straightness and balanced alignment supply the positive posture opposite the breach.
Gentle direction toward a route supplies movement that preserves rather than ruptures alignment.
Stable reality supplies the destination toward which the route is directed.
An extended traveled way supplies the line along which straightness is enacted.
The repeated peel-breaking image at the packet's close makes breach the final group-defining motion.
Falling into destruction supplies the terminus of sustained departure from the fitted route.

structural_cues: 46:13 gives a positive straight posture before the focus.
46:30 combines guidance, truth, and a straight path after the focus.
46:35 closes the packet by repeating the focus's final root in the group label linked to destruction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies straightness, guided route, repeated fisq, and destruction; I infer a path-and-container geometry from the focus branch's peel exit. The moral uses need not imply a literal spatial process.

changed_reading.before: Fisq is one more item in a list of moral offenses.
changed_reading.after: It names the motion produced by unsupported self-expansion: leaving a truth-fitted, guided course and rupturing the boundary that held life in alignment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it shifts from the focus verb's ordinary display branch to the same root's distant worldly-stock branch. It remains anchored in the exact display root beside expended good things and useful provisions. Downstream prose should present it only as imagistic wordplay, not as the verb's direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The displayed people at word 2 stand beside good things made to go away and enjoyed as provisions at words 7-12.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary display supplies the actual syntactic action performed on the people.
Worldly stock and exchange value supply the distant image of the consumers becoming exhibited inventory.
A provision used for needs supplies the object-status formerly assigned to the world.
Making the stock pass away supplies the completed consumption that precedes the reversal.

changed_reading.before: The people are simply shown the place of punishment.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical echo, those who treated the world as consumable stock become the stock placed on display after their own inventory is gone.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a non-dominant mapped target and a debasement-through-use branch for the punishment noun. It remains anchored in that exact split focus root and its immediate juxtaposition with self-serving use and claimed rank. Downstream prose should qualify it as a material-social analogy, not a lexical replacement for humiliation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Enjoyment at word 12, the punishment's h-w-n root at word 17, and self-greatness at word 20 form an use-status reversal.

activation_trace.role: Pleasurable use supplies the instrumental relation the agents imposed on their goods.
Debasing something through repeated use supplies the reversal from user to degraded object.
Elevated status and leadership supply the social height from which instrumental degradation falls.

changed_reading.before: The arrogant are made socially low.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, those who reduced good things to instruments of self-use undergo an instrumental reversal in which their claimed person-status is treated as cheap and usable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the non-dominant mapped root for the repayment form into a cutting-at-maturity image and combines it with the peel-exit branch. Both mapped targets are explicitly supplied for exact focus roots, so the activation is anchored, but downstream prose must call it a harvest metaphor generated by branch proximity rather than a proposed lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Good things at word 8, repayment at word 15, and the peel-breaking final act at word 27 permit a contained maturation-and-harvest image.

activation_trace.role: Genuine good produce supplies what could have been cultivated rather than merely consumed.
Maturity reaching the time of cutting supplies a distant harvest image for the moment of repayment.
Ripe soft fruit emerging from its peel supplies the organic outcome now ready to be gathered.

changed_reading.before: Repayment is only an abstract legal balancing of deeds.
changed_reading.after: As a contained alternate-root image, the life they cultivated ripens into its own harvest point, where the outcome is cut and gathered after the good stock was consumed.

strongest_changes: The paired reward formula and the immediately preceding degree-and-fulfillment statement turn punishment into graded exact settlement.
The approaching cloud misread as rain makes pleasure-shaped misrecognition coexist with the simpler reading of misused real goods.
The greater society's failed faculties widen good things from luxury to capacities whose proper benefit was disabled by knowing denial.
The repeated fire tableau converts presentation into a progression from sight, to admission, to embodied verification.
The closing contraction of worldly residence to part of a day recasts enjoyment as catastrophic allocation across unequal durations.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated focus roots changed function across the packet: display became misread appearance and then verification; earthly greatness became a false immunity claim; good use split into sterile consumption, grateful transmission, and disabled capacity. Distinct readings remain live, while alternate mapped roots preserve three explicitly contained images that a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The good things may denote material comforts narrowly or include faculties, relationships, and social enablement.
The cloud episode may alter the focus's account of valuation, or may only illustrate denial and impatience in a neighboring story.
The path-and-peel geometry is coherent but depends on carrying a concrete branch image into moral syntax.
The alternate mapped-root images for repayment and humiliation may be rhetorically productive while remaining too form-distant for ordinary commentary.
The final temporal contraction may express felt brevity rather than a literal ratio of durations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Those who turned aside are now put on view.** ع ر ض B002 is presenting a thing to view. This reverses 46:3’s `معرضون` under B005, turning one’s side away. The packet supplies the two directions; I infer judicial reciprocity between refusing presentation and compulsory presentation. `يعرض` is therefore not neutral arrival but reversal of their earlier posture.
2. **Good things were made to depart through terminal use.** ذ ه ب B006 is going or departure; ط ي ب B001 is the good and pure, and م ت ع B001 is benefit enjoyed and used. The causative `أذهبتم` followed by `استمتعتم` presents enjoyment as consumption that sends goods away. I infer that use becomes loss when confined to the nearer/lower side (د ن و B002). The rebuke is thus about exhausting goods within one horizon, not about benefit as such.
3. **Self-magnification is repaid as contemptuous abasement.** ك ب ر B006 is grandeur and self-magnification; ه و ن B003 is humiliation through contempt. Their opposed vertical roles form the mechanism. I infer that unjust elevation of self generates its inverse in recompense. `عذاب الهون` reads as a measured collapse of assumed height, coordinated with the ayah’s explicit matching formula `بما كنتم`.
4. **Transgression as emerging beyond a containing boundary.** The packet’s accepted ف س ق branch, B002, is a date emerging from its peel. Set beside earthly self-magnification `بغير الحق`, the image assigns the peel the role of a rightful limit and emergence the role of leaving it. I infer the norm-as-container relation; this is exploratory because the inventory offers only the material image. `تفسقون` consequently gains a concrete sense of breaking out from a protecting boundary.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 46:34 repeats the compulsory presentation and makes the reversal explicit through verbal acknowledgment and tasting. The final `الفاسقون` in 46:35 also confirms that the peel-emergence image of ف س ق B002 is a deliberate closing frame, though the moral arrow remains exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Presentation makes the spent trajectory of good things visible.** `يُعْرَضُ` activates ع ر ض B002, being brought forward for inspection, and `ٱلنَّارِ` activates ن و ر B002, burning fire. `أَذْهَبْتُمْ` activates ذ ه ب B006, causing departure or passing away, while `طَيِّبَٰتِكُمْ` activates ط ي ب B001, good, wholesome, or pure things. The packet brings the people forward and then addresses what they made pass away; I infer that presentation exposes not only persons but the direction in which their available goods were expended. This turns judgment into disclosure of allocation rather than the introduction of an unrelated charge.

2. **The nearer life became the sole horizon of benefit.** `ٱلدُّنْيَا` activates د ن و B002, the nearer, lower, or first side; `ٱسْتَمْتَعْتُم` activates م ت ع B001, taking benefit and enjoyment, with B007 supplying prolonged keeping for benefit. The packet says that wholesome things were made to pass within the nearer life and enjoyed there. I infer that the error lies not in benefit itself but in collapsing its time horizon: resources capable of sustained extension were consumed as though the near side were the whole. This changes the accusation from simple pleasure to terminal short-range allocation.

3. **Self-elevation on the lower ground returns as abasement.** `عَذَابَ` activates ع ذ ب B005, severe punishment; `ٱلْهُونِ` activates ه و ن B003, humiliation through contempt; `تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ` activates ك ب ر B006, self-magnification, and `ٱلْأَرْضِ` activates أ ر ض B001, ground or the lower domain. The packet explicitly joins punishment to arrogance with `بِمَا` and locates that arrogance in the ground without `ٱلْحَقِّ`, where ح ق ق B003 marks a valid owned right. I infer a measured reversal: rank was enlarged without a rightful basis in the low domain, so its completed return is experienced as the exposure of actual lowliness. Humiliation reveals the false elevation rather than merely counterbalancing it.

4. **Boundary-exit is named by an image of breaking through a containing skin.** `تَفْسُقُونَ` has only ف س ق B002 in the packet inventory, the fresh date emerging from its peel. The ayah coordinates this clause with baseless self-magnification as a second causal ground. The packet does not itself state a moral boundary image; I infer from the branch’s physical exit that the conduct has broken out of a containing norm, just as 46:19 described properly placed and fully measured acts. This dormant concrete image changes “transgression” into loss of the form that should have held conduct coherent.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 46:25 made the allocation exposed at 46:20 externally legible: only dwellings remain, and `كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي` activates ج ز ي B001 as matched requital. The later material remnant sharpened presentation as an audit whose result can persist in the world after the people themselves are absent.

baseline.text: İnkâr edenlerin ateşe sunulacağı gün onlara şöyle denir: “Dünya hayatınızda güzel şeylerinizi tükettiniz ve onlarla zevk sürdünüz. Yeryüzünde haksız yere büyüklük taslamanız ve yoldan çıkmanız yüzünden bugün alçaltıcı azapla karşılık göreceksiniz.”

findings.text: Daha önce sunulan uyarıdan yana dönenler, şimdi kendileri zorla incelemeye sunularak kaçınma duruşlarının karşılığını yaşar.
Güzel şeylerin kaybı zevkten değil, kalıcı yarar taşıyabilecek imkânların yakın hayat tek ufukmuş gibi tüketilip ötesiz kullanıma kapatılmasından doğar.
Aşağıdaki yeryüzünde haksız yere büyütülen benlik, gerçek yüksekliğinin bulunmadığını açığa çıkaran aşağılanma olarak ölçülü biçimde geri döner.
Yoldan çıkma, davranışı biçimli tutan koruyucu sınırı hurmanın kabuğundan çıkar gibi yarıp dışarı taşma görüntüsü kazanır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Commodity, husk, and vertical-status branches turn the judgment into an inventory and stripping operation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Worldly goods are a consumed allotment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A stock of desirable goods is taken out, used for immediate benefit, and found absent when the longer account opens.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bilinen günü güneşin doğuşundan batışına kadar süren zaman olarak tanımlar ve onu günler dizisinin tek bir birimi sayar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu iki kurucu özelliği de doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca sınırları gün doğumu ve gün batımıyla belirlenen gündüz süresini kapsar; belirsiz süre, devir ve olay anlamları ayrı dallardadır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Karşıtlığın geceyle kurulduğu ve sayılabilir birim özelliğinin bağlamdan zaten anlaşıldığı cümlelerde doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Güneşin doğuşu ile batışı arasındaki aydınlık zaman aralığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hem doğal gündüz sınırının hem de bunun tek bir sayılabilir birim olduğunun açıkça belirtilmesi gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sınırlandırılmış gündüz süresini ve onun tek bir gün birimi oluşunu birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, uzunluğu önceden belirlenmeyen süreyi ve bağlama bağlı devir anlamını kapsar; belirli gündüz aralığını veya olayın kendisini tanımlamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük olay, olayın gerçekleşmesi, şiddetli gün ve çoğulda yaşanmış olaylar kullanımlarını aynı dalda toplar. Bu çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak bunların tek bir yalın anlam değil, gün ile olay arasındaki aktarmaya dayanan bağlı kullanımlar olduğu açıkça belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, büyük veya çetin olayla bağlantılı mecazî ve kalıplaşmış kullanımlarla sınırlıdır; literal zaman süresi ve yalnızca Tanrı'ya bağlanan anma günleri dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Olayı anlatan biçimsel genişleme, şiddetli gün bildiren kalıplar ve çoğul olay anlamı ayrı yüzler olarak korunur; kalıp anlamları yalın kullanıma genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Büyük veya çetin bir olayın gerçekleştiği kritik günü ya da olayın kendisini anlatan aktarmalı kullanımdır. Bazı kalıplarda çok ağır bir gün, çoğul biçimde ise yaşanmış önemli olaylar anlamı taşır.

facets.statement: Gün sözü, büyük bir olay gerçekleştiğinde o kritik zamanı veya gerçekleşen olayı anlatmak üzere aktarılır.
Belirli kalıplarda günün çok çetin, ağır ve etkisi uzun süren bir gün olduğu vurgulanır.
Çoğul biçim, bilinen günlerde gerçekleşmiş önemli olayları veya tarihî vakaları anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gün sözünün büyük bir olayın gerçekleşmesine aktarılmasını, çetin gün anlatımında kullanılmasını ve çoğul biçimin olayları belirtmesini aynı anlamsal aile içinde verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gün sözünün bağlamda işaret edilen zamanı gösteren bir belirteçle birleştiğini, ortaya çıkan yapının o gün anlamına geldiğini ve yapıya göre çekimli ya da değişmez olabildiğini belirtir. Dal çerçevesi bu dilbilgisel ve gönderimsel yapıyı doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bağımsız bir gün anlamı değil, bağlamda daha önce veya sonra belirlenen güne gönderme yapan birleşik yapıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca gün ile bağlama işaret eden belirtecin birleşik yapısına aittir; yalın gün sözüne yeni bir kök anlamı olarak aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gün sözü bağlamda işaret edilen zamana gönderme yapan bir belirteçle birleşir ve o gün veya o sırada anlamını verir. Birleşik yapı, kuruluşuna göre çekimli ya da değişmez biçimde kullanılabilir.

facets.statement: Birleşik yapı, hangi gün olduğu bağlamdan belirlenen zamana gönderme yapar.
Yapı, birleşmenin dilbilgisel değerlendirilmesine göre çekimli veya değişmez biçimde gerçekleşebilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, uzunluğa karşıt olan en ölçüsünü ve bir şeyin yanını aynı anlam alanında açıkça verir. Bir şeyi enli kılma da bu uzamsal çekirdeğin ettirgen gerçekleşmesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın uzamsal anlamıyla sınırlıdır; özel tamlamalardan başka bir anlam aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin uzunluğuna dik uzanan en boyutu ya da bu boyutun belirlediği yan taraf; ayrıca bir şeyi bu yönde geniş duruma getirmedir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin uzunluğuna karşıt en boyutunu belirtir.
En boyutunun belirlediği yan veya taraf için de kullanılır.
Bir şeyi enli duruma getirme işlemini de kapsar.

concept_gloss.applicability: En boyutunu, bu boyuta bağlı yanı ve ettirgen genişletmeyi birlikte anlatan genel açıklama olarak uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Uzamsal karşıtlığı, yan ilişkisini ve ettirgen işlemi korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi başkasının görmesine veya değerlendirmesine sunmayı; mal, asker ve kitap gibi belirli nesnelerle açıkça örnekler. Dalın kimliği kendiliğinden görünme değil, bir failin yönelttiği sunmadır.

Malın satışa sunulması, askerin denetlenmesi ve kitabın okunup karşılaştırılması bu yapının özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin uzaktan veya bir yönden belirip görünmesini ve bu görünüşün bulut gibi beliren bir varlık adı olmasını destekler. Burada görünme, başkasının sergileme eyleminden bağımsızdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi araya girme, önünü kesme ve engel olma çekirdeğini doğrular; ayrıca işe kendini sokma ve insanları ayrım gözetmeden öldürme gibi yapılara uzanır. Bu yüzden dal yalnızca yoldaki fiziksel karşılaşma diye daraltılamaz.
